title: Assistant workflow
description: A state machine an LLM walks, one validated step at a time.

version.description: Workflow version, increased when its behaviour changes.

description.description: What the workflow does; shown to the model on every step.

state_schema.description: JSON Schema for the run state the model records its progress in.

start.description: Name of the state a run begins in.

limits.description: Guards that stop a runaway run.

max_steps.description: Most steps one run may take.

max_tokens.description: Most input plus output tokens one run may use.

max_retries.description: Most consecutive invalid replies tolerated within one step.

max_visits.description: Most times a run may enter the same state.

states.description: The states of the machine, by name.

model_tags.description: Tags a model must have to run a step. On a state they replace the workflow's list; an empty list on a state means any model.

instructions.description: What the model should do in this state.

tools.description: Names of the tools the model may call in this state.

next.description: Names of the states the model may move to from this one.

end.description: Entering this state finishes the run successfully.

on_error.description: State to go to, once per run, when a step in this state fails for good.

output.description: Kind of output the state produces; selects the output prompt snippet.
